title: chore: remove unavailable community apps
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Removes 56 catalog rows representing 54 approved review targets.
- Preserves 7 verified apps and excludes 2 inconclusive apps from this PR.
- Does not change retained-app metadata or screenshots.

| App | Reviewed target | Reason | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BeDream APP | https://bedream.xyz | The public product explicitly promotes uncensored character chat and doujinshi content. | In-app Browser: uncensored roleplay and Doujinshi navigation are visible |
| Anura Hub AI | https://meow-script.vercel.all | The catalog host does not exist in DNS. | DNS ENOTFOUND for meow-script.vercel.all |
| Film ze Snu | https://sen.i-ty.pl | The catalog host does not exist in DNS. | DNS ENOTFOUND for sen.i-ty.pl |
| rynzen | https://rynzen.uk/ | The catalog host does not exist in DNS. | DNS ENOTFOUND for rynzen.uk |
| Polli-com | https://polli-com.vercel.app/ | A private access-code gate blocks the public app. | In-app Browser: System Locked, AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY, and ACCESS CODE gate |
| Splash Tool | https://n8n-image-generator.vercel.app | The public deployment is disabled for nonpayment. | HTTP 402 DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED from Vercel |
| Heia - Polly Intelligence update | https://heia-polly.vercel.app/ | The public deployment is disabled for nonpayment. | HTTP 402 DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED from Vercel |
| Soy Cosmo | https://soy-cosmo.web.app | The destination now serves an unrelated legal-analysis product. | HTTP 200 page title CJF Pro - Analizador de Sentencias |
| Soy Cosmo | https://soy-cosmo.web.app | The destination now serves an unrelated legal-analysis product. | HTTP 200 page title CJF Pro - Analizador de Sentencias |
| PezzAI | https://chat.pezzai.com | The catalog host does not exist in DNS. | DNS ENOTFOUND for chat.pezzai.com |
| PollenQuill | https://zevrinbuilds.github.io/Pollendash-engine/ | The app requires terms acceptance before its restricted generation workflow can be used. | In-app Browser: Access Restricted plus mandatory terms checkbox

gist.headline: The garden got weeded
gist.blurb: The app garden got a careful cleanup: 56 stale catalog rows are gone, while 7 verified apps remain exactly as they were. Polli checked the labels twice.
gist.summary: Removed 56 catalog rows covering 54 unavailable or unsuitable community-app review targets, while preserving 7 verified apps and leaving 2 inconclusive apps untouched.
gist.impact: The community app catalog now leads visitors toward the verified apps that remain available, with retained app metadata and screenshots unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a gentle garden curator with a tiny clipboard, tending a cozy app-directory garden: healthy labeled code-plants remain in neat pots while faded, empty pots are being quietly cleared away. Use a small CRT monitor robot to help inspect the surviving plants, emphasizing careful verification rather than failure or removal.
